title: DFI 5.0 PHY-side model: DDR command decode with bank state, write path (tphy_wrlat) and read path (trddata_en, tphy_rdlat) timing checks, byte masks, init and low-power handshakes, over an 8-bank DRAM array

fields.desc: initialisation done (held while dfi_init_start stays high); same as the pin
low-power request acknowledged; same as the pin

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a command before init, in low power or with cke low; ACT to an open bank; RD / WR to a closed bank; REF / MRS with a bank open; a missing or unexpected dfi_wrdata_en / dfi_rddata_en beat. Sticky in the core until PRESETN, so the bit is set again on every clock

notes: Every DFI signal passes through unchanged; dfi_clk is PCLK (1:1 ratio). The MC drives commands and data beats on the pins; the registers report the handshake state and protocol errors.
Timing: T_PHY_WRLAT 4, T_RDDATA_EN 3, T_PHY_RDLAT 5, init 32 cycles.
